# netbox_wireless_lans (Data Source)

Lists wireless_lan objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_wireless_lans" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: group_id, group_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, ssid, ssid__empty, ssid__ic, ssid__ie, ssid__iew, ssid__iregex, ssid__isw, ssid__n, ssid__nic, ssid__nie, ssid__niew, ssid__nisw, ssid__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tenant_id, tenant_id__n, vlan_id, vlan_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `wireless_lans` (Attributes List) The matching wireless_lans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wireless_lans))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--wireless_lans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wireless_lans`

Read-Only:

- `auth_cipher` (String) Authentication cipher. One of: auto, tkip, aes.
- `auth_psk` (String, Sensitive) Pre-shared key.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type. One of: open, wep, wpa-personal, wpa-enterprise.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `group_id` (Number) Id of the wireless LAN group.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.location).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `region_id` (Number) Id of the region the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.region).
- `scope_id` (Number) Id of the scope object (see scope_type).
- `scope_type` (String) Content type of the scope. Derived from site_id, location_id, region_id or site_group_id when one of those is set; set it together with scope_id otherwise. One of: dcim.site, dcim.location, dcim.region, dcim.sitegroup.
- `site_group_id` (Number) Id of the site group the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.sitegroup).
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.site). Conflicts with the other scope aliases and with setting the scope_* pair directly.
- `ssid` (String) Service set identifier.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: active, reserved, disabled, deprecated.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `url` (String)
- `vlan_id` (Number) Id of the VLAN the wireless LAN is bridged to.
